description: Search the ArcGIS Hub catalog of open government geospatial datasets by keyword. Optionally scope to one organization with org_id (an ArcGIS orgId). Returns each dataset's name, summary, record_count, owner/org, and its Feature Service `url` — pass that url to query_layer / layer_info.

org_id.description: Optional ArcGIS orgId to scope results to one publisher (e.g. "RmCCgQtiZLDCtblq" = LA County).

name: search_datasets
title: Search Datasets
